nom: TATCHA The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily skin report the cream hydrates without greasy residue and helps with breakouts and pore appearance, though one oily-skin reviewer still notices slight greasiness by morning.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally find it hydrating and non-sticky, but a couple note it may be too light or not moisturizing enough for very dry skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers frequently call it their best match, balancing dry and oily zones without greasiness, though one notes no visible change in pores.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation and soothing hydration, while multiple others describe redness, breakouts, eczema, or fragrance-triggered irritation.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers in their 40s-60s report younger-looking, hydrated, smoother skin with no irritation.
segments.normal: One reviewer with generally good/normal skin reports it caused red dots/irritation on her face.

concerns.aging: Several mature reviewers (40s-65) report skin looking younger, smoother, and more hydrated with regular use; no dissent reported.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong, lightweight hydration and a 'glow'; one reviewer says it turns to water on skin and isn't as hydrating as hoped, and another says it may be too light for very dry skin.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report irritation, red dots, or redness, several linking it to fragrance or sensitivity; many other reviewers report no irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports her eczema developed after two years of use, linking it to an ingredient concern; others with sensitive/dry skin report improved comfort and no barrier issues.
concerns.spots: One long-term user reports it cleared stubborn acne of 20+ years and another says it takes away acne; by contrast, other reviewers report cystic acne, closed comedones, or breakouts after use.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers (including teens and adults) report fewer breakouts and clearer skin; one reviewer reports severe cystic bumps under the nose and small breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers commonly report reduced shine and no greasy residue; one reviewer notes slight morning greasiness.

extraits.texte: Tatcha moisturizers broke my skin out extremely bad under my nose. I currently have two cystic acne bumps. Small tiny bumps formed as well. The cystic acne is extremely painful. Would not wish on my worst enemy. Can we say refund?

extraits.titre: I used to LOVE this moisturizer
extraits.texte: in my young 20's, I used to absolutely love this moisturizer. I used it on and off for a while. I'm now 31, and wanted to level up my skincare. I wanted to love this so badly, but it broke me out and caused closed comedones all over my cheeks. so bummed- I had to return. it is HIGHLY fragranced even though it's non-comedogenic. I'm assuming my skin has become more sensitive to fragrance with age. I'd steer clear if you have sensitive skin!

Honestly, the product does what it says it will do. The issue is that I have sensitive skin and this product has fragrance.which makes my skin irritated and red. Therefore, I can't use it. Take the fragrance out!

Tatcha is really the best skincare brand out there! I have oily skin and this minimized oil and helped with breakouts but was still hydrating!! Perfect for oily skin and it goes great with their matcha cleanse! It is very expensive but definitely worth it! Also it is fragrance free so it did not irritate my skin! Definitely recommend!

Just purchased my SECOND jar of this fantastic facial cream!! Have tried gazillions of products over the years and finally FOUND THE ONE that truly is perfect for my COMBINATION skin I have a few oily areas forehead and nose but otherwise DRY FLAKY areas on the rest of my face This awesome cream is perfect and never feels greasy or thick Rather the opposite in that it absorbs completely very fast HIGHLY recommend this absolutely PERFECT combination skin facial cream enough!!!!!!

I absolutely love this cream as someone with dry sensitive skin I always struggled to find a cream that wouldn't break me out and would actually hydrate my skin. I was using the la roch posay before I bought this and I'm so happy I switched I feel so good in my skin and honestly see a difference every time I use it I would definitely recommend this product!

I have combination skin and am 65 years old This moisturizer is the best Ive ever used No irritation Totally absorbs into the skin I never have an oily looking complexion I have used numerous products but Tatcha is the best
